name: File backup, native engine (first, incremental: new / changed / deleted / permissions)
spec: Copy a folder tree to the server so that any run can be restored exactly
a tree of new, changed, deleted and permission-changed files; two runs
run 2 sends only what changed; every point restores byte-identical (SHA-256); deleted files gone from the newest point only

name: Delta chains (incremental / differential), long chain → new full
spec: Send only the changed parts of large files, and keep every point restorable
a large file changed in the middle N times; incremental and differential modes
each delta is small; every point of the chain restores identical; past the chain limit a new full copy is sent

name: File backup, restic engine
spec: Back up with restic to the server's restic store
a source tree, two runs with one change
second run adds only the change; restore identical; `restic check` clean; another set cannot read the repository

name: Filters, skipped folders, links
spec: Leave out what the set excludes; follow links only when asked
a tree with excluded folders, filter patterns and a symbolic link
excluded items absent from the restore, included ones identical; the link followed only with the option on

name: Unreadable data is an error (permission denied, locked file, folder gone)
spec: A file or folder that cannot be read is an error, never a silent success
a source with an unreadable subfolder; a source that is gone; all sources gone
partly unreadable = success with error (red); all gone = failure; last good backup kept and still restorable

name: Volume Shadow Copy (open files)
spec: Copy files that are open or locked by another program, consistent to one moment
a file held open with an exclusive lock and written during the backup
the file is in the backup with its content at snapshot time; the shadow copy is removed afterwards, also on failure

name: Maximum duration, stop from the admin site
spec: Stop a backup at its maximum duration or on request, and go on next time
a slow backup with a 1-minute limit; a stop sent from the admin site
the run ends as stopped (not success), nothing half-stored is visible, the next run completes

name: Upload limit, compression, low priority, wait while busy
spec: Honour the upload limit, compression and priority settings
a 20 MB source with a 1 MB/s limit; compression on / off
the transfer takes about 20 s; with compression the stored size is smaller; restore identical either way

name: Pre- and post-commands (with time limit)
spec: Run the set's commands before and after the backup, within a time limit
a pre-command that succeeds, one that fails, one that never ends
output logged; a failure stops the backup only when the set says so; a stuck command ends at the limit

name: Local copy beside the online backup
spec: Keep a second copy on a local disk / NAS beside the online one
a set with a local copy path
the local copy restores without the server, identical; a full local disk is a warning, not a lost online backup

name: SQL Server: full, differential, log; free-space check
spec: Back up SQL Server databases with native full / differential / log backups
a database with transactions committed between runs
restored .bak files load and contain every committed transaction; not enough room → the database skipped with a clear error

name: MySQL / PostgreSQL dumps
spec: Dump MySQL / PostgreSQL databases
two databases with known rows; one database that fails
the dumps load into a new server with the same rows; the failing database is an error; passwords never in a log

name: Oracle RMAN
spec: Run an Oracle RMAN online backup
an RMAN script and password
RMAN gets the password only on stdin; a failed RMAN run keeps the previous backup

name: HCL Domino
spec: Back up HCL Domino data folders
notes.ini with a data folder
the folders from notes.ini are backed up after the cache is flushed

name: System State (wbadmin / ntbackup)
spec: Back up the Windows System State
a Windows server
wbadmin output in the backup; a failure of wbadmin is a failed run

name: Bare-metal image
spec: Back up a bare-metal image of the computer
a Windows computer with a system volume
an image that boots on new hardware; tool failure = failed run

name: Hyper-V virtual machines
spec: Back up Hyper-V virtual machines
a VM, running
export of the VM restores and starts; a failed export is a failed run

name: VMware ESXi / vCenter
spec: Back up VMware virtual machines
a VM on ESXi / vCenter
the VM restores to another datastore under a new name

name: Microsoft 365 (mail, OneDrive, Teams)
spec: Back up Microsoft 365 mail, OneDrive and Teams
a tenant with mail, files and chats
items restored to the mailbox / OneDrive with their content

name: Google Workspace
spec: Back up Google Workspace
a domain with Gmail and Drive
items restored with their content

name: External programs: time limit, both streams, process tree
spec: Run any external program safely
a program that hangs; one that writes much to both streams; one that spawns children
stopped at its limit with its children; both streams read in full; never a hung backup or installation

name: Restore all / a folder / a file, native, any point
spec: Restore everything, a folder or one file, from any point
a set with 3 points; a request for point 2, one file
exactly the requested files, byte-identical to that point (SHA-256)

name: Restore to the original place: overwrite rules, existing files
spec: Restore to the original place safely
files that exist at the target, overwrite off / on
off: existing files kept and the result says how many were skipped; on: replaced; a failed file = error

name: Restore, restic engine
spec: Restore restic sets
a restic set with 2 snapshots
identical files from the chosen snapshot

name: Restore from the website (download)
spec: Restore from the website as a ZIP download
the encryption password, a point, 2 files
the ZIP holds exactly those files, identical; a wrong password refused; a hung restic stopped with a clear error

name: Restore on a new computer (key recovery, local index rebuilt)
spec: Restore on a new computer after the old one is lost
a new computer, the account and the encryption password
the keys come back, the local index is rebuilt, every file restores identical

name: Automatic restore test
spec: Prove automatically that the backup can be restored
a set with the restore test on
sample restored and compared; no source to compare = NOT CHECKED, never FAILED

name: Run commit (journal, roll forward), truncated/half objects refused
spec: Store a run all-or-nothing on the server
a run committed; the server killed during the commit; a truncated object
after restart the run is either fully there or not at all; truncated objects refused; repeated commit answered the same

name: Run lease, interrupted runs closed and recorded
spec: Never leave a run open or "Running" after the computer died
a run with no sign of life for 5 minutes; the same run reported by 3 paths
closed and recorded once as interrupted; the set can back up again at once

name: Retention (days / jobs / GFS), never the current version

dims.failure: a policy has no failing input; a bad policy value is a boundary

spec: Delete old versions by the retention policy, never the current one
versions over 40 days; policy 30 days / N jobs / GFS
only versions outside the policy deleted; every kept point restores identical; the current version never deleted

name: Verify, damaged object quarantined and resent; index rebuild
spec: Find damaged stored data, quarantine it, get it again
a stored object with flipped bytes
found, quarantined, resent from the source; the index can be rebuilt from the objects

name: Quota (compressed / original), stop new backups, keep existing
spec: Stop new backups at the quota and keep what exists
a user at 100 % of the quota
new backup refused with QUOTA; existing points restore; the warning at the set percentage

name: Server disk full
spec: Say clearly that the server disk is full
a server disk filled during a backup
507 DISK_FULL, a clear message on the computer, one alert to the administrators, space of the failed run given back

name: Replication to a second server
spec: Copy everything to a second server
a commit on the main server
the same objects, database and logs on the replica

name: Earlier versions of the storage open as they are (upgrade with existing data)
spec: Open data written by earlier versions
a store written by version N-1
every point restores identical after the upgrade

name: Recycle bin for deleted sets / customers
spec: Undo deleting a set or a customer
a deleted set
restorable from the recycle bin until it expires

name: Backup of the server settings
spec: Back up the server settings
the server configuration
a copy that restores the settings

name: Scheduler: times, days, several a day, missed runs (computer off, offline)
spec: Start backups on time: once per due time, never twice, and catch up missed ones
a schedule of 3 times a day; the computer off at one of them; a restart of the service
each due time runs once; a missed time runs once at start-up; nothing runs twice after a restart

name: "Back up now" and "Stop" from the server reach the computer
spec: "Back up now" and "Stop" from the admin site reach the computer
a press of Back up now; a press of Stop
the run starts within a minute; Stop ends it as stopped

name: Settings changed on the server reach the computer
spec: Settings changed on the server reach the computer
a set edited in the admin site
the computer uses the new settings in its next run

name: Heartbeat, open-run note, report of a dead run
spec: Keep the server informed while a run is alive
a long run; the agent killed
progress every minute; the dead run reported at the next start

name: Network: server unreachable, line cut, reconnect
spec: Survive network trouble
the line cut during upload; the server unreachable; a request whose answer is lost
the run resumes or ends as failed with a clear reason; a repeated request is not counted twice; the next run completes and restores identical

name: Local state (chunk index, keys) — lost, damaged
spec: Recover from lost or damaged local state
the local index deleted / damaged
rebuilt from the server; the next backup is correct and restores identical

name: TLS: built-in TLS 1.2 for old Windows, certificate pin
spec: Talk TLS 1.2 on old Windows and pin the server certificate
a server certificate; a different certificate
the pinned one accepted; another refused

name: The agent on .NET 4.0 (Windows 2003 / XP era)
spec: Run on .NET 4.0 (old Windows)
the net40 build under mono
the same backup and restore results as net8

name: Administrator sign-in: password, mandatory two-step, lock, sessions, sign-out
spec: Only administrators get in, with two steps
right / wrong password, right / wrong code, 10 failures, sign-out
right + right = in; anything wrong refused; locked after failures; after sign-out the session no longer works

name: Customer sign-in, register a computer, device token
spec: Customers and their computers sign in
a login, a registered device token, a revoked token
valid = allowed; revoked = refused at once

name: Sign-up from the client with the contract
spec: Sign up from the client with the contract
a new customer accepting the contract
account created with the contract recorded

name: Guard: IP blocking (guessing, spraying, scanning)
spec: Block addresses that guess or scan
many failed sign-ins from one address
the address blocked; others not affected; the administrator alerted

name: Encryption: keys (password / random / custom), check value, tamper detection
spec: Encrypt data so that only the key holder can read it
data with key A; reading with key B; a changed byte
B cannot read; the changed byte detected

name: Customer limits, vendors (resellers) see only theirs
spec: Each reseller sees only its own customers
two vendors with customers
each sees and changes only its own

name: API refuses junk and attacks clearly
spec: The API refuses junk and attacks clearly
malformed, oversized, path-traversal and unauthenticated requests
clear 4xx refusals; nothing written outside its place

name: Server installation (wizard / script), Windows service, certificate, port
spec: Install the server
a clean Windows Server
service running, certificate bound, port open, admin site answers

name: Client installation (Setup.exe wizard), service, uninstall, reinstall
spec: Install / uninstall / reinstall the client
Setup.exe on a clean computer, then uninstall, then reinstall
service running, registration kept on reinstall, nothing left after uninstall

name: Client update (all or nothing)
spec: Update the client all-or-nothing
an update while the service runs; a file that cannot be replaced
all files new and the service back; or all old (rolled back) and the result says why

name: Server update (signed, SHA-256, from files)
spec: Update the server only with a signed package
a signed package; a changed package
signed installed with data kept; changed refused

name: Client packages: Windows, Linux, Mac; branding and server inside
spec: Build client packages with branding and the server inside
a branded package request
Windows / Linux / Mac packages that connect to this server

name: Reboot of the computer: service back, runs go on
spec: Survive a reboot
a reboot during idle and during a backup
service back; the interrupted run recorded; the next run completes

name: Last backup vs last result; history of every run; tasks page
spec: Show the truth: last backup vs last result, every run in the history
a success then a failure
last backup = the success; last result = the failure (red); both runs in the history

name: Running now (live list) — no ghost
spec: Show only runs that are really running
a run that ended; a run whose computer died
neither stays in "Running now"

name: Mails: run report, failure, missed backup, quota, disk full
spec: Send the right mail, and no false one
a success, a failure, a missed backup, quota, disk full
one mail of the right kind each; no failure mail for a success; no duplicate

name: Service calls opened / closed by backup results
spec: Open and close service calls from backup results
a failure, then a success
a call opened, then closed

name: Ransomware suspicion: retention frozen, alert
spec: Suspect ransomware and freeze retention
a run that changes most files with one new extension
retention frozen, administrators alerted

name: Computers: list, disconnect, move to another customer with backups
spec: Manage computers
disconnect a computer; move it to another customer
its token stops working; backups move with it

name: Licence: editions, limits, check-in
spec: Enforce the licence
an edition with limits; a check-in
limits applied; check-in recorded

name: Admin site: every page opens, no errors; sign-in, reload, sign-out
spec: Every admin page opens without errors
each page, reload, sign-out
no console errors; sign-out ends the session

name: Admin site: set editor (every tab saved and read back)
spec: The set editor saves every tab
a change on each tab
read back the same; reaches the computer

name: Admin site: the truth after failures (red, failed, not running)
spec: The admin site shows the truth after failures
a failed run; a dead run
red, failed, not running

name: Client window (every page, typing kept)
spec: The client window works
each page; typing in a field during a refresh
pages open; typed text kept

name: Client installation wizard (Welcome → License → Install → Finish)
spec: The client installation wizard
Welcome → License → Install → Finish
each step reachable; Back / Cancel work; the service installed

name: Partner portal and licensing centre
spec: Partner portal and licensing centre
a partner session
licences and packages managed

name: Translations (13 languages), Hebrew screens
spec: Every screen in 13 languages, Hebrew right-to-left
each language
no missing keys; Hebrew screens laid out right-to-left

name: AI: explain a failed run, insights, forecasts
spec: AI explains failures and forecasts
a failed run log
an explanation without secrets

name: Large installations: 500 customers, 5 000 sets stay fast
spec: Large installations stay fast
500 customers, 5 000 sets
pages within the time limit

name: Shared formats: messages, profile, log lines, run ids, atomic file writes
spec: Read and write the shared formats exactly, and never leave a half-written state file
messages, a profile with unknown attributes, log lines, a write interrupted midway
what is written reads back the same; unknown attributes are kept; a reader never sees a half file
